title: Refined Gem
description:
Curate a custom Refined card pool from the Card Library and replace your run card sources with the Refined Gem relic.

[h1]How to use[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Enable Refined Gem in the in-game mod menu.
[*] Open Card Library (compendium). Use Edit Refined Pool to toggle cards into your pool from any character/pool filter.
[*] Use Import to append cards from pool JSON files, Export to save a named copy into Pool Files, or Clear to empty the pool.
[*] Select the Refined filter to review your curated pool.
[*] During a run, obtain Refined Gem (including from Neow). While you hold it and your pool is non-empty, combat rewards, shop cards, and card transforms use that pool.
[/olist]

If your Refined pool is empty, the relic has no card-pool effect.

[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]
Each player uses their own curated pool. All players need the same Refined Gem version (this mod affects gameplay).

Requires Slay the Spire 2 0.107.1+.
changeNote: Card Library: import pool JSON files, export a named copy into Pool Files, and clear the Refined pool.
